annotations.title: Payment settlement ETA (ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow, check)

description: Payment settlement ETA (ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow, check) — When will a US payment land? Given a send time (at=, default now; tz=) and optional amount=, returns settlement time and value date for Fedwire wires (6 pm ET cutoff, 9 pm ET prior-evening open), Same Day ACH (10:30/2:45/4:45 ET windows, $1M cap), next-day ACH (8:30 am ET), RTP ($10M cap), FedNow and check deposits (Reg CC next-day $275, second-day rest, large-deposit exception). Uses the Federal Reserve holiday calendar (Saturday holidays: Fed open Friday). rail= all|wire|ach|same-day-ach|rtp|fednow|check (comma list). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
